risk_if_not_implemented: Without Post-Employment Requirements Awareness, personnel are more likely to make unsafe decisions, fall victim to social engineering, mishandle data or violate requirements. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, this deficiency most likely exposes the organization to Lack of a security-minded workforce (R-SA-2), and most likely increases susceptibility to Dysfunctional Management Practices (MT-8), Human Error (MT-9), Statutory / Regulatory / Contractual Change (MT-11), Workforce Shortage / Loss of Critical Skills / Labor Disruption (MT-25).

compensating_control_1.name: User Provisioning & De-Provisioning
compensating_control_1.description: Mechanisms exist to utilize a formal user registration and de-registration process that governs the assignment of access rights.
compensating_control_1.justification: User Provisioning & De-Provisioning (IAC-04) provides access control enforcement that compensates for the absence of Post-Employment Requirements Awareness (HRS-08.3) by restricting system and data access to authorized users through alternative identity and access mechanisms. Given the people-oriented nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Access Agreements
compensating_control_2.description: Mechanisms exist to require internal and third-party users to sign appropriate access agreements prior to being granted access.
compensating_control_2.justification: Access Agreements (HRS-07) provides access control enforcement that compensates for the absence of Post-Employment Requirements Awareness (HRS-08.3) by restricting system and data access to authorized users through alternative identity and access mechanisms. Given the people-oriented nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
